description: Turkish KGM-lineage precast pretensioned I-girders I90-I170: total depths 900/1200/1400/1700 mm with identical flange and web dimensions across types (top/bottom flange 750 mm wide, web 200 mm, flange thickness 150 mm assumed constant from the family's documented worked example). Effective spans 18-23 m (I90), 24-29 m (I120), 30-33 m (I140), 34-35 m (I170). KGM adopts AASHTO / AASHTO LRFD for design; the section and tendon layout are fixed in each bridge's approved application project.

sources.profile: Ozturk & Ozturk, IMO (Insaat Muhendisleri Odasi) technical paper citing Yapi Merkezi Prefabrikasyon 2007; KGM Teknik Sartnamesi (Karayollari Genel Mudurlugu, Part 320) governs materials/erection; TKIC precast I-beam design guide (AASHTO LRFD worked example).
sources.note: No published section-property tables exist for the family; validation is against closed-form analytic values for a plain symmetric I-girder. The 150 mm flange thickness is assumed constant from the documented worked example - cross-check against KGM-approved project drawings before fabrication use.
